summary: Tested Roommate Pairing (API+UI) and Invoice Email endpoint. Backend endpoints all work; UI loads but FAILS to fetch data due to wrong sessionStorage token key. Also found backend services were down (MongoDB + uvicorn) and had to be started manually.
passed: POST /api/bookings creates bookings with room_type='shared' (2 test bookings created)
POST /api/admin/pair-roommates with 2 ids pairs both bookings (roommate_id set on both docs reciprocally)
POST /api/admin/pair-roommates with 1 id returns 400 'Exactly 2 booking IDs required'
POST /api/admin/unpair-roommate removes roommate_id from both docs
Homepage loads and 'Castlerosse' Park Resort text present in HTML
Admin login UI works - redirects to /admin dashboard
/admin/roommates page renders with Zimmerpartner-Verwaltung heading, counters, and sidebar nav item
PDF invoice generation (generate_trip_invoice_pdf) succeeds (3678 bytes) when invoked directly

failed.area: Frontend - Roommate Pairing UI token key mismatch
failed.issue: RoommatePairing.js reads sessionStorage.getItem('token'), but admin login stores the JWT under key 'hbh_admin_token' (as seen in ImageManager.js and other admin pages). Result: all 3 API calls (fetch/pair/unpair) send no Authorization header -> 401 -> UI shows 'Fehler beim Laden der Buchungen' and 0 bookings even though backend returns 2.
failed.evidence: /app/frontend/src/components/admin/RoommatePairing.js lines 19, 47, 65 use sessionStorage.getItem('token'); /app/frontend/src/pages/ImageManager.js uses 'hbh_admin_token'. UI screenshot shows 'Fehler beim Laden der Buchungen' and 0/0/0 counters despite backend returning 2 shared bookings.

failed.issue: POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/send-invoice returns 500 with empty detail. Root cause: send_transactional_email returns None (likely EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY auth with upstream fails) and inner HTTPException is re-wrapped losing message. Per task note this is 'acceptable' if structure is correct, but error surface is poor (empty detail).
failed.evidence: curl -X POST .../send-invoice -> HTTP 500 {"detail":"Failed to send invoice: "}. Backend log: 'Failed to send invoice: ' (empty). PDF gen itself works.

failed.issue: At test start, backend uvicorn (port 8001) and MongoDB (27017) were both not running; supervisord not running. Public URL returned Cloudflare 502. Had to manually start mongod and uvicorn to proceed.
failed.evidence: ps aux showed no uvicorn/mongod/supervisord; curl to public URL returned 502 Bad gateway.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/components/admin/RoommatePairing.js: replace sessionStorage.getItem('token') with sessionStorage.getItem('hbh_admin_token') at lines 19, 47, 65.
Investigate why supervisord/mongod/backend were not running - likely a pod/env startup issue needing proper supervisor restart in the environment.

Improve send-invoice error handling: surface the real reason (missing EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY or upstream failure) instead of empty 500 detail. Optionally return 202/warning when email key missing but PDF generated OK.
